articles.description: miliq.news "60 مليون دينار بدون فوائد".. الاعمار تحدد موعد قروض الإسكان الجديدة بمدة تسديد 15 عاماً "60 مليون دينار بدون فوائد".. الاعمار تحدد موعد قروض الإسكان الجديدة بمدة تسديد 15 عاماً بغداد- ميل حددت وزارة الإعمار والإسكان والبلديات العامة، شهر كانون الثاني المقبل، موعدا لإطلاق القروض الخاصة بصندوق الإسكان . وقال المتحدث الرسمي باسم الوزارة استبرق صباح، إن "الوزارة سبق أن أطلقت رابط التقديم على قروض صندوق الإسكان في بغداد والمحافظات نهاية شهر آب الماضي، وتم قبول الطلبات الخاصة بعشرة آلاف مقترض إلى جانب تمشية ستة آلاف معاملة مدوَّرة من العام الماضي". وأضاف، أن "صندوق الإسكان باشر بعد قبول الطلبات، بإجراءات استكمال معاملات المقترضين عبر تطبيقه الخاص على الهواتف النقالة"، مبيناً أن "المبلغ الكلي لكل قرض يصل إلى 60 مليون دينار كحدٍّ أقصى، ووفقاً لمساحة العقار وراتب الموظف أو الكفيل، مع اعتماد مدة تسديد تصل إلى 15 عاماً". وأوضح صباح، أن "الصندوق مموَّل ذاتياً، وبالتالي فإنه يعتمد سياسة تركز على فتح رابط التقديم كلما سنحت الفرصة بذلك بعد تجميع مبلغ معين من استرداد أقساط المقترضين واستكمال الإجراءات الإدارية والفنية المتعلقة بهذا الصدد". وأشار إلى أن "الوزارة تمتلك خطة عمل لإطلاق القروض خلال العام المقبل وفق مدة التسديد ذاتها"، لافتاً إلى "وجود إقبال كبير من المقترضين نظراً لعدم وجود فوائد سوى تحميلات إدارية بسيطة لا تتجاوز 2 بالمائة من قيمة القرض". ودعا المتحدث الرسمي باسم الوزارة المقترضين السابقين، إلى "الالتزام بمواعيد تسديد الأقساط، لأن المبالغ يجري تدويرها لمستفيدين آخرين"، معرباً عن أمله "بإطلاق مبادرات لتمويل الصندوق إنسجاماً مع التوجه الحكومي لدعم قطاع السكن". جميع الحقوق محفوظة (ميل نيوز)

articles.description: miliq.news صوت الرعد يتردد.. سحب ركامية تلبد سماء العراق منذرة بغيث وشيك صوت الرعد يتردد.. سحب ركامية تلبد سماء العراق منذرة بغيث وشيك بغداد- ميل أصدرت الهيئة العامة للأنواء الجوية والرصد الزلزالي، اليوم الثلاثاء، تقريراً عن الحالة الجوية المتوقعة، أشارت فيه إلى تحوّل الأجواء إلى غائمة جزئياً مع فرص لتساقط زخات مطر خفيفة إلى متوسطة الشدة أحياناً في أماكن متفرقة من البلاد، مع احتمال حدوث عواصف رعدية ولا سيما في المناطق التي تشهد نشاطاً للسحب الركامية. وتوقعت الهيئة بحسب التقرير الذي ورد إلى "ميل"، أن تكون درجات الحرارة مقاربة ليوم أمس في المنطقتين الوسطى والشمالية، مع انخفاض طفيف في المنطقة الجنوبية، فيما تميل الأجواء إلى الاعتدال خلال ساعات النهار، مع برودة نسبية خلال ساعات الصباح الباكر والليل . وأضافت، أن الرياح شمالية غربية خفيفة إلى معتدلة السرعة، مع فترات من النشاط في المنطقتين الوسطى والجنوبية، مثيرةً للغبار الخفيف في المناطق الصحراوية تحديداً، وتنخفض في مناطق الغبار والأمطار إلى ما بين 5 و7 كم . أما درجات الحرارة العظمى المتوقعة في عموم البلاد : بغداد 31، نينوى 28، كركوك 29، السليمانية 28، أربيل 29، دهوك 27، صلاح الدين 31، ديالى 31، الأنبار 29، كربلاء المقدسة 32، النجف الأشرف 33، بابل 32، واسط 34، الديوانية 33، ميسان 35، المثنى 35، ذي قار 36، البصرة 36 درجة مئوية. جميع الحقوق محفوظة (ميل نيوز)

articles.description: Iraqi Minister of Communications Mustafa Sanad inaugurated on Sunday Iraq’s first satellite ground station in Baghdad. Iraqi Minister of Communications Mustafa Sanad and officials during the inauguration ceremony of Iraq’s first satellite station. Photo: Communication Ministry Baghdad (IraqiNews.com) – Iraqi Minister of Communications Mustafa Sanad inaugurated on Sunday Iraq’s first satellite ground station in Baghdad, a step aiming to bolster digital sovereignty and develop the country’s telecommunications infrastructure. In a speech he delivered during the inauguration ceremony, Sanad said that Iraq’s acquisition of a satellite would be impossible without a ground station. The new facility will serve as a cornerstone for the country’s upcoming national space program, with future expansions planned to establish additional ground stations across other Iraqi provinces depending on population density and administrative assessment. The station also acts as a complete technological hub that includes a satellite communication gateway, a localized data center, and an internet exchange point. Developed in partnership with the technology group Commercis, the station links incoming satellite communications directly into Iraq’s expanding domestic fiber-optic terrestrial network. Iraq previously relied on international infrastructure located outside its borders to route satellite traffic. The government is now actively urging ministries, private companies, and security agencies to migrate their traffic to this local gateway to secure sensitive data. The station is part of a broader economic vision to transform Iraq into a regional data corridor. By leveraging its geographic location, Iraq aims to serve as a high-speed data transit bridge connecting networks across Asia, Africa, and Europe. The station provides high-speed enterprise internet, secure government communications, live television feeds, and commercial satellite broadcasting.

articles.description: KRG Deputy Minister of Natural Resources Ahmed Mufti outlines an energy roadmap, citing $10B in annual waste and urging a dedicated gas licensing round. Baghdad (IraqiNews.com) – Iraq requires approximately eight billion standard cubic feet per day (scfd) of natural gas to achieve uninterrupted, 24-hour national electricity generation, according to Ahmed Mufti, Deputy Minister of Natural Resources in the Kurdistan Regional Government (KRG). In an analytical op-ed reviewed by the Iraqi News Agency (INA) on Sunday, October 18, 2026, Mufti highlighted that structural inefficiencies and energy waste cost the federal treasury roughly $10 billion annually, urging Baghdad and Erbil to launch a specialized gas licensing round and redirect industrial subsidies toward core infrastructure and upstream extraction. The KRG energy official pointed out that state-funded fuel subsidies for heavy industries—predominantly cement and steel plants—absorb nearly $8 billion annually. While commending the federal cabinet’s revised pricing mechanism for heavy fuel oil (black oil), which reduced subsidies to sell fuel to industrial plants at $400 per ton against an international benchmark of $650, Mufti emphasized that realized fiscal savings should be channeled directly into natural gas transmission networks. Transitioning heavy industry clusters, such as those in Sulaymaniyah’s Bazian district consuming 3,000 tons of fuel oil daily, to natural gas would significantly lower production costs, curb emissions, and free up heavy crude volumes for high-value export markets. Mufti outlined substantial upstream potential across key underdeveloped non-associated gas assets, including Akkas in Anbar and Mansuriya and Khashm Al-Ahmar in Diyala, calling for an investment licensing round backed by robust legal, security, and sovereign payment guarantees. Highlighting the Kurdistan Region’s foreign-investment model, he noted that output from the Khor Mor gas field surged from 350 million scfd in 2020 to 750 million scfd today, pushing aggregate regional gas production close to one billion scfd. Further development of adjacent fields—such as Chamchamal, Kurdamir, and Topkhana—could elevate regional production to between two and three billion scfd. To bridge supply shortages, Mufti proposed an integrated “gas-to-power” framework, where gas-fired generation in the north feeds directly into the federal transmission grid, cementing economic alignment between Baghdad and Erbil. He concluded with strategic recommendations, including the establishment of a joint federal-regional security command to protect critical energy infrastructure, the swift settlement of delayed payments to international oil and gas operators to sustain drilling campaigns, and the formal redesignation of Iraq’s Ministry of Oil as the “Ministry of Oil and Gas” to reflect the fuel’s central role in future industrial strategy.

articles.titleKo: 이라크, 세계은행과 전략 프로젝트 자금 조달 논의
articles.summaryKo:
이라크 재무부 장관과 세계은행 부총재가 전략 프로젝트 자금 조달 및 경제 개혁 지원에 대해 논의하였다.
이 회의는 방콕에서 열린 국제통화기금(IMF) 및 세계은행 연례 회의의 부대 행사로 진행되었다.
이라크는 세계은행의 전문성과 재정 기여를 통해 에너지, 교육, 교통, 디지털 전환 분야의 주요 프로젝트를 추진할 계획.
세계은행은 이라크 정부의 경제 및 재정 목표를 지원하기 위한 추가 이니셔티브를 강조.
이라크 정부는 비유가 수입원 다변화 및 민간 부문 역할 강화를 통해 경제 안정성을 강화할 방침.
세계은행의 역할을 통해 이라크의 경제 및 재정 변화를 도모할 계획.
'이라크 비전 2050'을 통해 유가 의존도를 줄이고 포괄적이고 지속 가능한 경제 성장을 목표.
세계은행과의 협력은 이라크의 경제 개혁 및 프로젝트 추진에 긍정적인 영향을 미칠 것으로 예상.
articles.description: The Iraqi finance minister and the World Bank Group discussed on Thursday financing strategic projects and support for economic reforms. The World Bank headquarters in Washington. Photo: Lauren Burke/AP Baghdad (IraqiNews.com) – Iraqi Finance Minister Faleh Sari and World Bank Group Vice President for the Middle East and North Africa Ousmane Dione discussed on Thursday financing strategic projects and support for economic reforms in Iraq. The meeting took place on the sidelines of the annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the World Bank Group, held in Bangkok, Thailand, according to a statement released by the Finance Ministry. Sari stressed the World Bank’s role in Iraq’s economic and financial transformation. He outlined the country’s desire to use the World Bank’s expertise and financial contributions to carry out significant projects in the energy, education, transportation, and digital transformation sectors. The step aims to promote sustainable development and improve the efficiency of public services in Iraq, according to Sari. Dione praised the collaboration with the Iraqi Finance Ministry, indicating that it has efficiently arranged its operational and communication mechanisms with the World Bank. The World Bank official highlighted that the efforts of the Iraqi government pave the way for additional initiatives to support the country’s economic and financial goals in the upcoming period. Sari reaffirmed last week Iraq’s commitment to continuing economic and financial reforms, diversifying revenue sources, and strengthening the role of the private sector. According to Sari, these measures aim to bolster economic stability and enhance the country’s capacity to deal with regional challenges. Sari noted that the government is addressing the economic consequences of the crisis in the Strait of Hormuz by reprioritizing expenditures, increasing non-oil revenues, and maintaining the state’s essential obligations while pursuing structural reforms. “Iraq Vision 2050” represents a strategic plan for reducing dependency on oil, broadening production, empowering the private sector, and achieving inclusive and sustainable economic growth, according to Sari. The minister noted that the reform package includes enhancing public financial management, automating customs and tax operations, boosting the business and investment climate, upgrading the banking sector, and increasing electronic payment systems. According to Sari, the partnership with the IMF and the World Bank Group supports the economic and financial reform program.
